prompt:
CONCEPT REFERENCE ONLY (art direction study, not a game asset). A gameplay-style screenshot mood study for a modern 2D pixel-art roguelike action game, same world, same steep three-quarter top-down camera and same modern high-detail pixel-art style as the attached image (crisp pixels, rich mid-tones, painterly light), but a completely different location - do not reuse the attached composition. Camera: orthographic, the floor is seen from above on a square grid; every wall, building and large structure shows its tall FRONT face (about two tiles high) so characters can walk behind them. Scale: the screen shows about 30 by 17 floor tiles and a character is about one and a half tiles tall. The middle of the screen is an open, calm, low-contrast floor that stays readable for combat; height, props and light sources sit around the edges.

Scene: the boss arena - the ruler's open-air banquet terrace at the heart of the liquor empire, at night. The north edge is a raised stone dais, its front face a tall wall of carved stone steps and plinth; on the dais, centered, a tall throne built from stacked oak casks with a huge, heavy, utterly drunk lord slumped on it holding a giant goblet (he is about three tiles tall), a big iron brazier burning behind the throne, heavy drapes with a goblet emblem hanging between stone pillars. The arena floor is large polished stone slabs with a big goblet emblem inlaid in the center circle, wet with spilled amber liquor in a few puddles, otherwise calm and open for a boss fight. West and east edges are long wrecked banquet tables with overturned goblets, bottles and guttering candelabras, a few passed-out revelers slumped on the floor, toppled casks. The south edge is a stone balustrade (front face visible) beyond which the dark city rooftops lie far below.

Lighting: dark blue-gray night, deep shadows, strong vignette. The brazier behind the throne back-lights the ruler so his silhouette reads clearly; candelabras on the tables and the spilled liquor cast smaller warm amber pools with bright glints on goblets and wet stone. One small dark-coated figure with a wide-brimmed hat stands at the south of the open floor facing the throne.

Palette: charcoal and cool slate grays with subtle blue-gray in the shadows, warm umber wood, dirty pale plaster or stone, and a single warm amber/ember accent for every light source. No saturated blue, green, purple or red. No text, no letters, no logos, no UI, no HUD, no watermark, no frame.
